name: io.github.hepter/i18n-codelens-mcp
description: Inspect, audit and safely edit i18n locale JSON files from AI agents.

environmentVariables.name: WORKSPACE_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path of the project whose locale files should be managed. Defaults to CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR or the working directory.

environmentVariables.name: I18N_CODE_GLOB
environmentVariables.description: Glob for source files scanned for t("key") references (default **/*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx}).
